settingsPage.label: Resource settings

history.title: Playback history
history.description: Your most recently watched available files. Select a file to resume from its saved position.
history.empty: No playback history yet. Watch a file from your library to see it here.
history.unknown: Scan your library to check which watched files are available.

errors.SUBTITLE_EXTRACTION_FAILED: Could not extract the subtitle. Retry or choose another track.
errors.SUBTITLE_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: FFmpeg is unavailable on the server.
errors.SUBTITLE_TOO_LARGE: The subtitle exceeds the size limit.
errors.PLAYBACK_CONFLICT: The source changed. Reopen the file.
errors.SUBTITLE_PREPARATION_UNAVAILABLE: Subtitle preparation is unavailable on the server.

compatibility.label: Playback compatibility
compatibility.failed: Compatibility could not be checked. You can retry or try the original file.
compatibility.supported: This browser reports support for this file.
compatibility.unsupported: This file is not supported by this browser.
compatibility.unknown: Playback compatibility could not be confirmed.
compatibility.reasonUnknown: The available information does not establish whether this file can play.
compatibility.runtimeFailed: Actual playback failed. Browser support information does not guarantee playback; check the file and connection or retry.
compatibility.performanceWarning: This browser reports that playback may not be smooth.

reasons.browser-supported: The browser accepts the described container and codecs. Actual playback remains the final check.
reasons.browser-rejected: The browser rejects the described media configuration.
reasons.container-rejected: The browser rejects this container type.
reasons.incomplete-description: The media parameters are insufficient for a precise browser query.
reasons.missing-evidence: The browser did not provide capability information.
reasons.browser-uncertain: The browser cannot confirm support without trying playback.
reasons.api-unavailable: The required browser capability API is unavailable.
reasons.query-timeout: The browser capability query timed out.
reasons.native-track-selection-uncertain: This file has multiple media tracks. Native playback may select a different track.
reasons.hdr-display-unverified: HDR decoding and display behavior require actual playback validation.
reasons.no-video-stream: No usable video stream was found.
reasons.no-audio-stream: This file has no audio stream.
reasons.original-supported: The original file can be tried without preparation.
reasons.insufficient-evidence: There is insufficient evidence to choose a preparation mode.
reasons.packaging-change-required: The original streams can be retained with different packaging.
reasons.audio-encoding-required: The audio needs conversion; retain the original video.
reasons.video-encoding-required: The video needs conversion; retain compatible audio.
reasons.audio-video-encoding-required: Both audio and video need conversion.
reasons.stream-combination-unverified: The browser has not confirmed support for the unchanged audio and video together.

preparation.title: Media preparation
preparation.description: Prepare a reusable browser copy when the original cannot play. Existing compatible streams are retained.
preparation.listDescription: Server tasks continue when you leave this page. Deleting a prepared copy keeps the original file and viewing history.
preparation.empty: No preparation tasks yet. Open a file to prepare a browser copy.
preparation.sourceUnavailable: The source is not available yet. Scan or reconnect the library.
preparation.blocked: This browser and profile cannot provide a confirmed playback path.
preparation.direct: The original file can be played without preparation.

failure.interrupted: Preparation was interrupted. Retry to restart.
failure.cache-missing: The prepared copy is missing. Retry to recreate it.
failure.cache-full: The cache is full. Delete a prepared copy and retry.
failure.storage-full: There is not enough free disk space.
failure.source-changed: The original file changed. Reopen it to create a new task.
failure.profile-changed: The output profile changed. Create a new task with an available profile.
failure.tool-unavailable: FFmpeg is unavailable on the server.
failure.capability-missing: The server lacks a required media capability.
failure.capability-unknown: The server media capability could not be confirmed.
failure.processing-failed: Media preparation failed. Retry after checking the server.

preparation.settingsDescription: Choose the output profile used by pre-transcoding in the library. Compatible streams are retained automatically.
preparation.required: This browser cannot play the original file. Pre-transcode it from its folder before watching.
preparation.waitForCopy: The prepared copy is not ready yet. Playback will start when preparation finishes.
preparation.copyUnsupported: No available prepared copy could be confirmed for this browser. Check the task or choose another profile in Settings.
